ثمامة بن عبد الله بن أنس بن مالك

notes: «عن أنس بن مالك أن أبا بكر كتب لهم» — the author of the letter is the last link, since the words relayed are his writing (rule 6); the Prophet quoted in the letter is not a link
«أنس بن مالك» stands twice; occurrence 2 is the one after «عن»
